rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dll {
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLL via configuration artifacts"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
    strings:
        $a = { 2e 72 63 64 72 00 } // ".rcdr" - C2 domain artifact
        $b = "beacon.dll" fullword ascii
        $c = { 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? 68 ?? ?? ?? ?? e8 ?? ?? ?? ?? 83 c4 08 } // push beacon config
    condition:
        all of them
}
